repos_data.description: A blazing fast AI Gateway with integrated guardrails. Route to 1,600+ LLMs, 50+ AI Guardrails with 1 fast & friendly API.

AI gateway / AI control plane / AI proxy written in Go. Unified OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, xAI, Ollama, vLLM and more. A LiteLLM alternative with observability, guardrails, streaming, cost tracking, intelligent routing, sticky sessions, failover, real-time logs and usage tracking. Prod ready.

Local gateway for Claude Code, Codex and other AI clients on macOS, Windows and Linux: switch upstreams without touching clients, keep API keys from relays, cut off malicious tool calls, trace every request.
Open-source AI gateway for LLMs & AI agents, built in Rust. One OpenAI-compatible API for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock & more — routing, guardrails, caching, rate limits, observability.
OpenAPI-generated MCP server for TokenLab model discovery, pricing, chat, native System One decisions, media, files, embeddings, webhooks and async tasks.
Self-hosted OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible gateway: give each AI agent run a dollar budget, enforced before the provider, with a payload-free per-run cost record.
